issue_summary: Customer reports earbuds intermittently disconnect from phone after installing the latest firmware update.
Second report of random Bluetooth disconnects after the firmware update; engineering team notified.
Customer reports the heart rate sensor gives inconsistent readings during high-intensity workouts.
When two units are paired in stereo mode, one speaker drops the connection after roughly 20 minutes.
HDMI output flickers intermittently at 4K60 on certain laptop models (reported with a Dell XPS).
Spacebar occasionally registers a double keypress; suspected stabilizer defect on a subset of units.
Power bank does not reach the advertised 20W charging speed unless using the bundled cable.
Minor cosmetic complaint: case material yellowing after about two months of daily use.
